audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[].side read LeBlanc, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill while content win[] and the packet levelChart read Skill, LeBlanc, LeBlanc, LeBlanc, LeBlanc, Ekko, Ekko — disagreement on all seven rows.
audit.why: The content chart matches the kit. Level 1 LeBlanc has only a 700-range sigil and no detonator, so it is even; from 2 to 6 the Sigil-plus-detonation pattern and Ethereal Chains' root own the lane; Ekko takes over once an item lets him punish a spent 15-second Distortion.
audit.corrected: All seven full-layer sides moved onto the content chart, with every changed row's why and rating rewritten in the same group. win[] already holds the target values, so there is no paired win[N] value change.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] placed 'a Mimic reset' in the level 3-5 window.
audit.why: Mimic is her ultimate (45/35/25s) and is not available before level 6.
audit.corrected: spikes[0] rewritten around what actually exists at 3-5: the 3.5-second sigil mark, any ability detonating it, and Ethereal Chains on 14s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five fields (whys[1], spikes[0].text, content early, wants.you[0], wants.foe[0]) attributed the root to Sigil of Malice.
audit.why: Sigil of Malice marks a target for 3.5 seconds and is detonated by any follow-up ability; it applies no CC. The root is Ethereal Chains (E, 14/13.25/12.5/11.75/11, 925 range), which shackles first and roots 1.5 seconds later. Also never stated anywhere: Mirror Image drops her invisible for 1 second below 40% health and leaves a clone, which matters because Phase Dive is a targeted teleport that can be spent on the wrong LeBlanc.
audit.corrected: Root reassigned to Ethereal Chains everywhere, the sigil described as a mark-and-detonate, and the Mirror Image clone written into dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and the packet flagged zero cooldown-sequencing advice in this matchup.
audit.why: Distortion 15/13.75/12.5/11.25/10 with a 4-second return, Ethereal Chains 14s, Mimic 45/35/25, Chronobreak 110/80/50 are all available.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, and explicit 'wait for X then Y' sequencing added to dosFull[1].d, phases[3].why and breakdown.mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: 17 misgendering fields (LeBlanc called he/his/him), dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim, dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim, and dosFull[2].t promised a 'post-combo silence' LeBlanc does not have.
audit.why: LeBlanc is female per champ-gender.js; bled bullets do not explain their titles; no silence exists in her kit.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed, both bled bullets replaced, dosFull[2].t retitled to the real trigger.

audit.why: packet flagged 'Land Sigil of Malice' in wants.foe[0] as a suspect name; the name itself is correct — the defect there was the claimed root, which is fixed under point 4.
